- Left blue moved from (34, 14) to (29, 14) - moved 5 rows up!
- Right blue stayed at (44, 39) - didn't move

- LEFT/RIGHT: control the right blue (horizontal movement)

Actually, looking back at the history:
- Initial: left blue at (49, 19), right blue at (49, 39)
- After UP x5: left blue at (39, 19), right blue at (44, 34)
Wait, the right blue moved from (49, 39) to (44, 34) after UP x5. So UP also moved the right blue up (from row 49 to row 44).
But now, when I pressed UP, the right blue didn't move (stayed at row 44). So the right blue can only move up once (from row 49 to row 44), and then it's stuck.
Or maybe the right blue moved up because it was initially at row 49, and UP moved it to row 44. But now it's at row 44, and UP doesn't move it further.
Actually, looking at the right blue's surroundings:
- Rows 39-43, cols 39-43: OOOOO (open)
- Rows 44-48, cols 39-43: SSSSS (blue)
- Rows 44-48, cols 35-38: BBBB (wall)
- Rows 44-48, cols 44-49: BBBBB (wall)
So the right blue is in a corridor with walls on both sides (cols 35-38 and cols 44-49). The blue can move up (rows 39-43 are open) or down (rows 49+ might be open).
But when I pressed UP, the right blue didn't move. Maybe the right blue can only move horizontally (LEFT/RIGHT), not vertically.
Let me reconsider the movement pattern:
- UP: moves the left blue up
- DOWN: moves the left blue down
- LEFT: moves the right blue right (opposite direction!)
- RIGHT: moves the right blue left (opposite direction!)
Wait, that's confusing. Let me re-examine:
- When I pressed LEFT: right blue moved from col 34 to col 39 (right)
- When I pressed RIGHT: right blue moved from col 39 to col 34 (left)
So LEFT moves the right blue right, and RIGHT moves the right blue left. The directions are opposite!
This is a key insight. The arrow keys control the blues in opposite directions:
- UP: left blue moves up
- DOWN: left blue moves down
- LEFT: right blue moves right
- RIGHT: right blue moves left
Now, the left blue is at (29, 14). Let me check what's above it.
